scripts.build: npm run build:checkout && npm run build:demo && npm run build:dist
scripts.build:dist: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dest = path.join('demo', 'dist', 'checkout'); fs.cpSync(path.join('checkout', 'dist'), dest, { recursive: true }); console.log('Unified dist ready at demo/dist');"
